caption: The drawing depicts a long dress with an overcoat-style outer layer and a contrasting underskirt. The outer layer is blue with a delicate white floral pattern and is elaborately designed with a fitted bodice and wide, flowing skirt. The sleeves are long and end in double layers of ruffled white lace at the elbows, creating a tiered, flared look. The neckline is square and trimmed with what appears to be additional lace or light-colored detailing. The underskirt is cream or light beige with a faint, intricate linear pattern that includes curved and floral motifs. Off to the right, there is a simplified line sketch of the back view of the same dress, showing the full volume and drape of the skirt and the ruffled lace at the sleeves. The background of the drawing is plain and beige.
title: Dress
